title: The TDR suggestion has no agreed start operation: the legacy treatment side calls rwb-agent in process, Architecture v5 gives no S2-to-P10 call, and no source gives the harness environment, the TDR model stub controls, the evidence format or the gate
source: Template and Rules v1 section R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13, 16 and 18; legacy RWB-E2-032 sections 12 and 15
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan
description: The two sides disagree about how a TDR suggestion starts. The legacy story (RWB-E2-032 sections 4 and 12) has the treatment side call ModelSuggestionClient.suggestOffer in process on rwb-agent and wait for the answer inside the treatment transaction. Architecture v5 slide 13 gives the S2 Treatment row no call to P10: its cells are P7 T E, S5 T, P8 T E and ACE Common N only. Slide 16 starts agent runs only from CaseCreated and DocumentStored, and the Ownership Map has no rwb-agent operation that starts a suggestion run. No source read gives the other values the harness needs either: the SIT harness environment and its seeding, the TDR model stub and its 61 s and -12 controls, the OFF-policy fixture, the evidence format and retention, and the pass and fail gate.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives owners and operations only
proposed: The rwb-treatment and rwb-agent owners agree one one-hop REST operation on the rwb-agent contract that starts a TDR suggestion run, and the QA lead fixes the harness environment, the stub controls, the evidence format and the gate at the wave 2 entry check.
